current_activity: holds the Ninth Army north flank west of Geilenkirchen under XIII Corps
notes: Event date: 8 November 1944 (Siegfried p401: the XIII Corps, controlling the 113th Cavalry Group and the complete 102d Division, took over defense of the seventeen-mile line west of Geilenkirchen on 8 November; the CMH table lists XIII Corps from 7 November). Event definition: the 102nd Division, in its first weeks on the Continent, is the infantry of the XIII Corps defensive line until the British relieve it; it also appears in the 84th Division's attack sector on 18 November. Relationship: XIII Corps (CMH table, 7 November), Ninth Army and 12th Army Group assigned. Location: Atlas lists the division at Brunssum on 2 November and Heerlen on 12 November; the later entry is used (four days). Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Heerlen. Event support: high (Green Book narrative). Location support: low (four days to the later atlas entry; no listing for the day).
